items.title: How much does a deliberately targeted opportunity move the needle?
items.description: This is not a real promotion formula. It is a toy model showing that targeted evidence is stronger than untargeted effort. Each opportunity deliberately aimed at the named gap adds evidence strength; extra opportunities only help if they match the same gap.
items.compute: const evidenceScore = Math.min(100, params.targetedOpportunities * 70); const missingEvidence = Math.max(0, 100 - evidenceScore); return { evidenceScore, missingEvidence };
